Subscribe and 🔔 to the BBC 👉 https://bit.ly/BBCYouTubeSub
Watch the BBC first on iPlayer 👉 https://bbc.in/iPlayer-Home Jamie Dornan, star of 'Fifty Shades of Grey', explains and demonstrates his particular style of toe-to-more-toe walking.

Graham is joined by entertainment duo Ant and Dec, Fifty Shades of Grey star Jamie Dornan, Breaking Bad actor Aaron Paul.

The award-winning host continues his anarchic talk show. Expect the unexpected as top celebrity guests join in the fun with Graham and his irrepressible audience.

The Graham Norton Show | Series 14 Episode 18 | BBC
